instruction: Find a one-way flight from Madrid to Berlin for one adult departing on the 5th of next month.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: One way flight search from Madrid (MAD) to Berlin (BER) for 1 adult departing on 5th of next month. Uses same evaluator pattern as original - parses URL parameters to verify search criteria. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts URL parameters from active tab to verify flight search criteria
Complete coverage: checks all instruction requirements (origin MAD, destination BER, 1 adult, 0 teens/children, one-way flight, departure date)
Proper use of rule_relativeTime for dynamic date calculation ('5th next month' converts to absolute date at runtime)
Correct metric logic: check_direct_json_object performs exact matching of extracted URL params against expected values
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts URL params -> replace config maps tpStartDate to time -> metric compares all fields
Time format template {Year}-{Month0D}-{DayD} appropriately handles date formatting with zero-padding
